messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Help: "Disconnected from server"
parts:
You cannot use absolute paths when referring to files. In this case you have "c:" which is a windows path. Shinyapps.io is Linux.

See http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#debugging-your-application for more details
On Mon, Jun 5, 2017 at 04:39 Alexis Mayer <alexi...@hotmail.fr> wrote:
Hi, 

I have a problem when i publish my app, in local everything works well.. I think the problem come from ordering readOGR. It has already been mentioned but i do not get away with it.
